capabilities: Answer questions over the vault with traceable citations that open the exact note and heading
Run model-planned lexical retrieval in fast (curated Wiki) and precise (full Markdown scan) modes
Expand retrieval through outgoing links, backlinks, and Wikilink expansion without an embedding service
Stream OpenAI-compatible answers with cancellation and non-streaming fallback
Run an index diagnostics command comparing vault-visible files with indexed coverage
disambiguation: Despite the Copilot name, it does not write or edit notes; it answers questions with citations and currently does not automatically modify Wiki or source notes.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; works on mobile (isDesktopOnly false) with device-local IndexedDB indexing; API keys are stored in Obsidian Secret Storage; no embedding service is required. Roadmap items (refine-and-save workflow, hybrid embedding retrieval) are not implemented.
motivation: The README frames the goal as treating a vault as a structured knowledge system instead of a flat collection of interchangeable chunks.
problem: Vault-wide AI chat treats notes as flat interchangeable chunks and needs embedding services, losing structure and traceability.

relations.evidence: Choose DeepSeek, OpenAI, or another OpenAI-compatible service in the plugin settings.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible model service (DeepSeek, OpenAI, or other)

summary: Question-answering plugin that builds a persistent LLM Wiki from the vault and answers with local lexical retrieval and traceable citations.
